s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

raw.syndrome_frame: Progressive facial swelling and sinus pressure with nasal septum deviation and proptosis
salient_findings: Heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with solid and cystic components
key_facts: Several months of sinus pressure and facial swelling
Several weeks of external deviation of the nasal septum
No significant past medical history
Left nasal mass on examination
Mild left-sided proptosis
CT scan showed a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus
Mass eroded the orbital floor, medial and posterior maxillary walls, and anterior ethmoid air cells
Displacement of inferior rectus without muscle invasion
Left maxillary alveolar ridge and several molar roots involved
Bony changes showed remodeling and thinning
Biopsy showed spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells
Rare mitotic activity
No cytologic atypia

differentials: sinonasal schwannoma with new bone formation

raw.rationale: The biopsy results showing a spindle cell process with significant multinucleated giant cells and the imaging studies revealing a heterogeneous mass in the left maxillary sinus with erosion of surrounding structures are consistent with a solitary fibrous tumor.

rejected.label: sinusitis
rejected.why: While sinusitis could explain the sinus pressure and facial swelling, it does not account for the mass seen on imaging or the specific biopsy findings.

rejected.label: silent sinus syndrome
rejected.why: This condition typically presents with enophthalmos and facial asymmetry due to chronic maxillary sinus hypoventilation, which is not consistent with the mild proptosis and mass seen in this case.

rejected.label: rhinitis
rejected.why: Rhinitis would not explain the presence of a mass in the maxillary sinus or the specific biopsy results.

rejected.label: nasal obstruction
rejected.why: Nasal obstruction is a symptom rather than a diagnosis and does not account for the mass or biopsy findings.
